description: This file provides a TypeScript implementation for managing Chrome DevTools Protocol sessions via a custom MCP (Managed Chrome Protocol) interface. It includes functions for session management, page/tab operations, element interactions, and script evaluation, utilizing external SDKs and custom error handling.

classes.name: ChromeMcpStructuredPage
classes.description: Represents a structured page object with id, optional URL, and selection status.

classes.name: ChromeMcpToolResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a Chrome MCP tool command, including structured content, raw content, and error status.

classes.name: ChromeMcpSession
classes.description: Encapsulates a session with a Chrome MCP client, including the client instance, transport, and readiness promise.

classes.name: ChromeMcpSessionFactory
classes.description: Type definition for a factory function that creates Chrome MCP sessions given a profile name and optional user data directory.

methods.name: asRecord
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a record if it is an object and not an array.

methods.name: asPages
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of structured pages, filtering invalid entries.

methods.name: parsePageId
methods.description: Parses a string target ID into a finite number, throws if invalid.

methods.name: toBrowserTabs
methods.description: Converts structured page objects into browser tab representations.

methods.name: extractStructuredContent
methods.description: Extracts structured content from a tool result.

methods.name: extractTextContent
methods.description: Extracts text content lines from a tool result.

methods.name: extractTextPages
methods.description: Parses text content to extract page information based on specific line formats.

methods.name: extractStructuredPages
methods.description: Attempts to extract structured pages; falls back to text pages if structured content is absent.

methods.name: extractSnapshot
methods.description: Extracts a snapshot node from a tool result, throwing if missing.

methods.name: extractJsonBlock
methods.description: Extracts and parses a JSON block from a string, handling markdown code fences.

methods.name: extractMessageText
methods.description: Retrieves message text from a tool result, prioritizing structured message.

methods.name: extractToolErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message for a tool result, including the tool name.

methods.name: extractJsonMessage
methods.description: Attempts to parse a JSON message from a tool result, trying multiple candidates.

methods.name: normalizeChromeMcpUserDataDir
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a user data directory path.

methods.name: buildChromeMcpSessionCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key string from profile name and user data directory.

methods.name: cacheKeyMatchesProfileName
methods.description: Checks if a cache key corresponds to a given profile name.

methods.name: closeChromeMcpSessionsForProfile
methods.description: Closes all sessions associated with a profile, optionally keeping a specific session.

methods.name: buildChromeMcpArgs
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for Chrome MCP, including user data directory if provided.

methods.name: createRealSession
methods.description: Creates and initializes a real Chrome MCP session, connecting to a client and verifying tools.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cached Chrome MCP session for a profile and user data directory.

methods.name: callTool
methods.description: Calls a specific tool command within a Chrome MCP session, handling errors and responses.

methods.name: withTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file, executes a callback with its path, then cleans up.

methods.name: findPageById
methods.description: Finds a page by ID within a profile, throwing if not found.
